title: Exact finite-step support locality for the all-bond Q3 split approximant
question: For a finite Q3 graph, does an onsite-plus-all-bond split step map every cylinder support into its closed one-layer neighborhood, so that N split steps depend only on the rooted N-ball and not on the distant shape?
method: Represent the all-bond interaction as V=c sum_{<xy>} q_x q_y and verify exact pairwise commutation of all configuration-multiplication factors.
Derive the kick identities Ad(B_delta)(q_x)=q_x and Ad(B_delta)(p_x)=p_x+delta*c*sum_{y~x}q_y by the first BCH commutator, with the second commutator zero and both time signs retained.

Combine the kick closed-neighborhood map with the declared site-local onsite-flow support hypothesis and iterate it on edge, square, rectangular, cube and path graphs for every registered source and step.

Check rooted induced-ball isomorphism between path5 and path7 at radius two, compare the mapped support trajectories, reproduce the rows in a non-importing graph-construction lane and compile Lean R337 for the scalar BCH and neighborhood fixtures.
finding: The exact all-bond kick leaves q_x fixed and shifts p_x only by neighboring q coordinates; the second BCH commutator vanishes. Under the explicit site-local onsite-flow hypothesis, both split orders and both time signs map a source support into its closed one-layer neighborhood at each step. Iterating gives the exact N-ball envelope for N steps. The path5/path7 rooted radius-two balls are isomorphic and their mapped three-step support trajectories agree, so fixed-N split support is independent of distant shape.
decision_reason: This closes the finite-N combinatorial locality input that had previously appeared only as an informal one-layer statement. It isolates the remaining analytic obligation: a uniform split-to-exact Trotter rate and domain control sufficient to exchange N-to-infinity with volume exhaustion. The result is not promoted to common alpha or QFT dynamics.

adversarial_review.check: All bond generators are q-polynomials, so shared vertices do not create nonzero bond-bond commutators; momentum commutators are not used in the factorization.
The p-shift sign follows from [p_x,V]=-i*hbar*c*sum_{y~x}q_y, and the opposite time sign reverses the shift; both are checked by the scalar fixtures.
Onsite support preservation is explicitly conditional on the site-local self-adjoint flow and is not inferred from finite-dimensional truncations.
The N-ball statement is exact at fixed split count N only; no Trotter-count limit or uniform-in-N bound is asserted.
Only the induced rooted N-ball and an explicit isomorphism are compared; no arbitrary-shape norm or global graph equivalence is claimed.
The support map is algebraic cylinder bookkeeping and does not establish unbounded-domain invariance, product density or a common core.
R337 proves exact rational BCH and finite neighborhood fixtures only; it does not formalize Q3 unbounded dynamics or limits.
Uniform Trotter convergence, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion interchange, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

qft_interface.closed: At fixed split count N, the support of a cylinder observable is confined to the graph N-ball and is determined by the rooted N-ball, for both term orders and time signs.
qft_interface.open: A volume- and cutoff-uniform analytic Trotter rate, common unbounded core, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, N-to-infinity/exhaustion interchange, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence, canonical A1/R-192 production owner, physical-empty reference or Sector-A closure is supplied.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite-step support theorem under an explicit site-local onsite-flow hypothesis. It is not a thermodynamic dynamics theorem or a QFT/Clay result.
next_action: Use this exact finite-N locality lemma as the combinatorial input for a uniform split-to-exact Trotter estimate on the Q3 common core; if the estimate cannot be made uniform in N and volume, record the precise route obstruction before common-alpha promotion.
no_overclaim: This package proves only algebraic finite-N support locality under a declared site-local onsite-flow hypothesis. It does not prove the N-to-infinity Trotter limit, exhaustion independence, common alpha, KMS/GNS, a mass gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production or a Clay result.
